objection.status: error reported by an ordinary grader
objection.quote:
Consequently, either

* (i) $g\equiv 0$ (constant), which gives $f(x)=x$, a solution; or  
* (ii) there is $c>0$ such that $V \subseteq \{0, c\}$ with both values attainable.
objection.witness: At most one positive value does not imply every value is 0 or c. One must exclude g(x)=d<0; iterating (4) would give g(x+nd)=d and positivity of all x+nd, an eventual contradiction.
